info.name: Platform MVP End-to-End - API Gateway
info.description: Gateway-only MVP verification for authentication, user activation, task ownership/RBAC, soft delete, Kafka-backed task-created in-app notifications, refresh, and the currently pending logout contract. Registration and login produce user audit events; notification creation produces notification-service outbox events on platform.notification-events for future Audit Service consumption. Aligned with platform_240626_exclude.txt. Audit read API requests target Audit Service directly on port 8088. Admin authorization is required for Audit API reads; the audit folder verifies 401 and 403 handling first.

item.name: Regular User Creates Task Assigned to Admin

exec: pm.test('Assigned task creation succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
